titel: Why Your Snails Keep Coming Back

beats.say: Why do the snails you throw over the fence... keep *coming back?*
Rudi thinks it's a *new* snail every night. So he paints a dot on its shell.
Then he throws it over the fence. Next morning? *Same* dot. Same lettuce.
The fence didn't work, so Rudi builds a *giant wall.* The snail just climbs right over it.
Because garden snails have a *homing* instinct. They can find their way back from ten metres.
A physicist in London threw four hundred snails over his garden wall. One came back *seventeen* times.
But carry them *twenty metres* away... and almost none come back.
Here's the trick: carry them twenty metres to a wild patch. Just *not* into your neighbour's garden.
And next time a snail is back on your lettuce, and you wonder...
